questions.question: What is the nurse's priority action following an intramuscular injection into the ventrogluteal site when the patient complains of a sudden, sharp, radiating pain down their leg?

questions.explanation: Sharp, radiating pain after an IM injection, especially into the leg, is a strong indicator of possible nerve irritation or damage (e.g., sciatic nerve, even in the ventrogluteal site, though less common).
